findings.claim: The machine-readable release contract declares the wrong ESM extension for the npm package contract.
findings.evidence: `release/v3-release-contract.json` adds `"moduleContract": { ... "esmExtension": ".js" ... }`, while the package manifests and package evidence in the same diff use ESM `.mjs` paths, e.g. `packages/entity-graph-sync/package.json` sets `"module": "./dist/index.mjs"` and exports import default `"./dist/index.mjs"`; acceptance requires public API, package, documentation, and release ledgers to be synchronized.
findings.suggested_fix: Change `moduleContract.esmExtension` to `.mjs` or update all package outputs/manifests to match the contract.

findings.claim: The sync package now re-exports WebSocket Loro APIs from a module that is not included in the diff after the previous implementation was deleted.
findings.evidence: `packages/entity-graph-sync/src/index.ts` now exports `createWebSocketLoroChannel`, `encodeLoroWebSocketMessage`, and `decodeLoroWebSocketMessage` from `./providers/loro-websocket-channel`, while `packages/entity-graph-sync/src/providers/loro-provider.ts` removes the existing in-file `createWebSocketLoroChannel` implementation; the corrected `openspec/changes/v3-vite-react19-example/files.txt` lists `loro-loopback.ts`, `loro-provider.ts`, and related files but does not list `packages/entity-graph-sync/src/providers/loro-websocket-channel.ts`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `packages/entity-graph-sync/src/providers/loro-websocket-channel.ts` to the change with the exported functions/types, or keep/export the implementation from `loro-provider.ts`.
